g.text: MarieRank3Convo6 begins.
Update boolean MarieLyonAvailable
I must ask you a question, and I must implore you not to judge me for it, Drifter.
You've been thrown into an outlandish situation. Of course I won't judge you.
I will do my absolute best.
[End.]
Vraiment gentil to pay me such grace without knowing me or what I was about to write to you.
+10 Chemistry
Chat ends.
But... does the large-headed talking fish give you a headache as well ? Fibonacci ?
I do appreciate that, thank you.
Yes. Yes, absolutely. Thank you.
The notion of you being annoyed at Fibonacci is incredibly endearing.
No, actually. I adore him.
Then I am glad I am not alone. But, to be clear, I mean him no insult. If I feel out of sorts by nature of my current state of affairs, I imagine he endures as best he can.
Oh ? How so ? I suppose I am glad for it, but I am simply confused as to why. My headache is certainly not nearly so charming.
Then I can only beg your forgiveness, I mean him no insult. If I feel out of sorts by nature of my current state of affairs, I imagine he endures as best he can.
His means of doing so simply disagrees with me when I am subjected to it at length, is all.
I spend most of my time having to fight for my life. Little reminders of humanity like this is... kind of what I live for.
I suppose every now and then I have to take a step back and reflect on the absurdity of it all. A Norg and a priestess of Sol...
His means of doing so simply disagrees with me when I am subjected to it at length, is all.
Bah. I should not be complaining at all. I must bring Lyon his dinner tonight, he is once more laid out with a terrible megrim.
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
Bah. I should not be complaining at all. I must bring Lyon his dinner tonight, he is once more laid out with a terrible megrim.
Does he get them often?
Forgive me... a what?
Never lose that part of you, Drifter. Never let go of the part of you that seeks out those sparks of life.
Goodness me, when you put it like that, no wonder. It does sound like one of those childish jokes, n'est-ce pas ?
Oui, oui. Once every few weeks ? Once every two months ? The longest stretch I have seen him go without one is six months, perhaps.
Oh ! Dear. Hm. Think of a headache, but far more intense. I have heard some others call them bilious headaches. They are more common in women.
The world is all too eager to become a dark and serious place. All too ready to levy suffering upon us at every turn.
A Sister, a Priest, and a devil from the future get sent to the past... and then to the futur... and meet up with a fish, a deer-thing, a giant bird, and a butler...
Check boolean Megrim
I think we call them "migraines" now.
Huh. Megrims. Thank you.
We must seek out whatever brightness, whatever levity we can, even in the form of childishness if we must.
It is quite amusing, you are quite right !
I wonder what causes them.
true
false
That sounds awful...
true
false
I also get megrims. They're terrible.
true
I also get those kinds of headaches. They're terrible.
false
I wonder what other fascinating historical particularités we shall discover ! Exciting. I do love to learn new things. "Migraine." The journey was clearly not far.
Update boolean Megrim
Now only if Lyon would see it the same way.
Now if only my dear Lyon would see the brightness in it the same way.
He has his theories.
If you were to express your sympathies, I am certain they would be welcome. And despite how it may seem, he will appreciate the company.
You do ? You should tell Lyon. He needs to know others are capable of suffering in such a similar way.
Update boolean Migraine
No matter the name, Lyon is prostrate with one and shall be until morning. Poor man cannot see anything but a blur, nor feel his hands nor feet. And he tells me the pain is intolerable.
Update boolean MarieLyonSuffering1
Although it may be more correct to say that he had his theories, until lately.
Though his demeanor may attempt to dissuade you, I implore you to hold strong, Drifter. There is a man with great need buried beneath what seems a stoic and stony exterior.
+5 Chemistry
Ah, speaking of. I feel terrible for complaining about headaches. I must bring Lyon his dinner tonight, he is once more laid out with a terrible megrim.
Update boolean MarieLyonFaith1
I can be exceedingly stubborn. Don't you worry.
I've already got one Man in the Wall... why not two?
He is a grown man. If he wishes to talk, he can talk.
The Luminaries know he would otherwise willingly suffer alone...
+5 Chemistry
Jest with me in such a fashion, but do not make such remarks to him. The topic of your Indifférence is a sore one with him.
He is grown, yes. He is a man, yes. And I believe he wishes to talk. But I challenge you to question if he can talk.
Update boolean MarieLyonSuffering2
You will need it with him, I fear. Thank you, Drifter. He is my dearest friend, and a brother to me. And it breaks my heart to see him in such pain.
Be resilient. And patient. And kind. He is like a brother to me and is my dearest friend, Drifter. And it breaks my heart to see him in such pain.
Not all of us are equally gifted or feel that we are entitled to such things. He is in pain and believes it is his lot to be in pain.
We will speak again soon. Par la grâce de Sol.
He is also like a brother to me and is my dearest friend. And my heart shatters for him. So I simply can only ask you to... be patient. And kind. If you are capable.

Chat ends.
